entities.summary: Tianjin is a major international port city in China. It is a direct-administered municipality on the shore of the Bohai Sea making it separate from the surrounding Hebei province. It is one of the five national central cities, with a total population of 13,866,009 inhabitants at the time of the 2020 Chinese census. Its metropolitan area, which is made up of 12 central districts, was home to 11,165,706 inhabitants in 2015 and is also the world's 29th-largest agglomeration and 11th-most populous city proper. Tianjin is a city in East Asia. Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 153 Wikipedia editions). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
